data.name: Shivkaran
data.gender_notes: Shivkaran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God Shiva, Lord of the Universe
data.long_meaning: Shivkaran is a compound name made up of two words: Shiva and Karan. Shiva is the name of the Hindu god of destruction and transformation, representing both good and evil. Karan means 'cause' or 'doer'. Together, Shivkaran can be interpreted as 'God Shiva, the doer of the universe' or 'God of causes'. The name Shivkaran carries the meaning “God Shiva, Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shivkaran usually hope their child will grow to embody god shiva, lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shivkaran is a powerful name that represents the divine power of Shiva, the god of creation and destruction. It is believed to bring strength, courage, and protection to the bearer. It is also said to represent the ultimate reality, the universal consciousness, and the cosmic cycle of birth, death, and rebirth.
data.etymology: Shivkaran belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God Shiva, Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivkaran total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivkaran has significant cultural importance in the Hindu religion, as Shiva is one of the primary deities worshipped in India and other countries with large Hindu populations. The belief in Shiva as the destroyer and transformer of the universe reflects the cyclical nature of life, death, and rebirth. Additionally, the practice of Shivratri, a festival dedicated to Shiva, is widely celebrated each year.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Shivkaran highlights the belief in a higher power that transcends all earthly causes and effects. It emphasizes trust in God's will and the recognition that every individual is a doer, responsible for their actions in this world. This name can serve as an inspiration for living a virtuous life, demonstrating faith in the divine wisdom and guiding us towards our spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivkaran: Carrier of Shiva's Grace. The name signifies an individual deeply rooted in Shiva's teachings, bearing the divine blessings and guidance in their life journey.
